The '''P'frorin system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] that was located within the [[Bheriz sector/Legends|Bheriz sector]],<ref name="EAOC" /> a part of [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] portion of<ref name="Slice" /> [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" /> The system was home to the [[Species/Legends|creature]] known as [[P'frorin gotta-worm]].<ref name="The Clone Wars: Decide Your Destiny: Tethan Battle Adventure" /><ref name="Planetnamia" />

==Behind the scenes==
The P'frorin system was established in the [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] to the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', which placed the system in grid square U-10.<ref name="EAOC" />
